name: Cabin by the Lake
source:
When you were younger you were inseparable from the girls you grew up with, but as time past they moved away and you grew apart. But now you are coming to a reunion, to reconnect and see how you've all changed and grown. Although it might not go well at first, you find yourself back there again, with the power to change how things went.

What will you shape your relations into? Why is the past changing? And how is the reunion repeating?

[From [url=https://nunus-house.itch.io/cabin-by-the-lake]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你年轻的时候，你和一起长大的女孩形影不离，但随着时间的推移，她们离开了，你们也渐渐疏远了。但现在你们要重聚，重新联系，看看你们是如何改变和成长的。尽管一开始可能并不顺利，但你会发现自己又回到了原来的状态，并且有能力改变事情的进展。

你会把你们的关系塑造成什么样子？为什么过去会改变？重逢又是怎样的呢？

[来自[url=https://nunus-house.itch.io/cabin-by-the-lake]Itch.io[/url]]
